describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal animal shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of ground. Its entire body except for the back and forehead is covered in dense, long, shaggy brown fur that is darker on the lower legs and lighter tan on the chest and flank. The head is broad and bear-like with a lighter muzzle and dark nose. A single long, dark, ridged, glossy horn curves up from the center of the forehead. The dorsal side from the shoulders to the rump is covered by a large, highly glossy, dark reddish-brown to black segmented exoskeleton that sits on top of the fur, with a spiked shield over the shoulders and a domed, overlapping segmented section extending rearward. It stands on four thick furred limbs ending in clawed paws and has a very small rounded tail at the rear.

describe.description: The creature is a large, heavy-bodied quadruped standing in side view facing right, with the overall size, shape, dense shaggy brown fur, head, ears, muzzle, four thick legs, clawed paws, and short stub tail of a brown bear. Its entire back from behind the shoulders to the rump is covered by a glossy dark reddish-brown segmented dome with transverse bands and a lower row of side flaps pierced by oval openings. A single long slender backward-curving dark ring-segmented horn rises from the center of the forehead.
